Co-owner Lyle Cervenka noted plans to expand to additional valley locations in 2027.

Turquoise Wine Bar, a franchise concept that opened its flagship in Glendale, Arizona in 2022, is expanding through franchising after beginning its franchising journey last year. The concept operates as a community gathering space offering boutique small-lot wines, wine club memberships, and small plates. The article discusses the brand's franchise growth but does not specify a new location address or opening date.

Katsuya, a modern Japanese restaurant concept by sbe, will open its first Arizona location at the Kimpton Miralina Resort & Villas in Paradise Valley as part of the property's $70 million transformation. The restaurant will anchor a new luxury enclave and offer contemporary Japanese cuisine including sushi, robata-grilled specialties, and handcrafted cocktails. The opening is part of the final phase of Kimpton Miralina's redevelopment.

No exact opening date has been announced; the shopping centre is currently undergoing a major interior renovation expected to be completed later this year.

Twisted Cat Tavern, a Leesburg-based restaurant, is opening its second location in Lovettsville at 20 Town Square #100, with the debut expected later this month. The new location will initially offer a limited fan favorites menu before transitioning to the full menu after a few weeks.

The opening is led by Texas Coffee Partners President Eric Wollenhaupt.

7 Brew Coffee, one of the fastest-growing drive-thru coffee chains in the country, plans to open a location at 736 Hewitt Drive in Waco, according to public filings. The partnership, confirmed to launch in August, brings together an espresso program and a Brazilian bakery following a chance meeting at a local business incubator graduation ceremony. The collaboration is described as one of the more unique business partnerships in the Sacramento area.

Fire Shaka–Hawaiian BBQ, owned by Matt Miskelly, is opening its first true dine-in restaurant at 126 Laurens St. in downtown Aiken. The Hawaiian-inspired concept features plate combos with proteins such as roasted kalua pork, barbecue beef, and huli barbecue chicken, alongside sides like Hawaiian mac salad and Spam musubi. The team aims to open in August, following a recent debut at Georgia's Augusta Mall.

data.location: Old Eagle School Road, Wayne, PA (zip not specified)
data.short_description: ANEU Kitchens founder Meridith Coyle is bringing her most ambitious project yet to Wayne: a 20,000-square-foot commissary and wellness center on Old Eagle School Road featuring cooking classes and educational lectures. The new location follows successful cafes in Paoli, Bryn Mawr, Margate, Ocean City, Ardmore, and Valley Forge. No opening date or exact street address has been specified in the article.

data.status: awaiting a liquor license and final inspections
data.short_description: Bodega Bar ATL, which began three years ago as a New York City-inspired pop-up, is opening its first brick-and-mortar location at 1085 Katherwood Drive SW in Sylvan Hills. Owner Caleb Giles confirmed the 2,100-square-foot space has undergone cosmetic changes and is awaiting a liquor license and final inspections. The menu features New York City-inspired food including chopped cheese, General Tso's chicken, chicken parm, and cocktails, beer, and wine.

data.location: 2958 Beverly Glen Cir, Los Angeles, CA 90077
data.short_description: The Taco Stand, a Tijuana-inspired taco concept launched in 2013 by Shōwa Hospitality founders Julian Hakim and Aram Baloyan, plans to open a shop at 2958 Beverly Glen Circle in Los Angeles. The brand currently has 20 spots across San Diego, Orange County, Florida, Las Vegas, and Texas. Other California locations in Irvine and Mission Valley are also in the pipeline for this year.

Blind Hog BBQ is a new barbecue concept planned for 2245 S Eastwood Drive in Woodstock, IL, at the former Porkies Pig Roast location. The estimated opening date is sometime in August 2026. The menu includes brisket, pork ribs, turkey, pulled chicken, pulled pork, wagyu bologna, sausages, and sandwiches.

Sadboy Creamery is preparing to open a brick-and-mortar location at 1502 Marion Street in Denver, taking over the former French for Sugar space. Construction is currently underway, with the owner targeting a September opening. The shop will offer small-batch, handcrafted ice cream including pints, scoops, and other frozen treats.

Bacci's restaurant in Stoneham, MA, announced it will permanently close on July 11, 2026, ending its 19-year run. The owners cited the state of the economy as the reason for the closure. The restaurant is known for its casual dining room, full bar, and Italian-American menu.

La Mer is a new seafood restaurant planned for 856 Sea Lane in Aiken, SC, by restaurateur David Meunier. The menu will feature fresh fish and seafood including grouper, snapper, mahi-mahi, Dover sole, and lobster. Meunier is applying for permits and is targeting an October opening.

Las Vacas Gordas is a new Argentine steakhouse planned for 394 Park Ave in Aiken, SC, by restaurateur David Meunier. The concept is slated to debut 45 to 60 days after La Mer opens. Meunier describes it as a great steakhouse catering to Aiken's polo community and broader customer base.

David Meunier is planning a third restaurant concept — an English pub — in Aiken, SC, as part of the same block development alongside La Mer and Las Vacas Gordas. No address or opening date has been specified in the article. Further details were not provided.

Urban Hawker, a Singaporean food hall in Midtown Manhattan founded by KF Seetoh, announced its closure with a final day of operation on July 17, 2026. The closure is driven by the building owners' plans to sell the property for redevelopment. The food hall features 12 vendors serving Singaporean and Southeast Asian cuisine and opened in 2022.

data.location: 6919 Orchard Lake Rd, West Bloomfield Township, MI 48322
data.short_description: Game Day Social is a new sports bar and tavern under construction at 6919 Orchard Lake Road in West Bloomfield Township, MI. The owner does not yet have an opening date set but expects to announce one sometime next month. The menu includes pub-style food, craft cocktails, beer, wine, and seltzers.

Oh Yea Pizza is a new pizzeria planned to open at 3553 Richland Ave., Suite 158 in Aiken, SC, in late July 2026. The restaurant will serve classic and specialty pizzas, build-your-own options, strombolis, calzones, subs, an all-you-can-eat salad bar, and crispy wings. Promotions and giveaways are scheduled for the grand opening.

D-Spot Dessert Café is opening its first U.S. location on July 11, 2026, in Carrollton, TX, as part of the company's expansion beyond Canada. The café offers Belgian waffles, crepes, cheesecakes, handmade ice cream, milkshakes, burgers, sandwiches, and pasta. The grand opening will feature buy-one-get-one promotions, a $1,000 gift card giveaway, and family-friendly activities.

Gris-Gris, an award-winning Southern restaurant on Magazine Street in New Orleans, announced it will close at the end of July 2026 after eight years in operation. Owner and chef Eric Cook cited the decision as a business decision, with more details to be shared on July 9. For its final month, the restaurant is offering its original 2018 menu at 2018 prices.

Nan Xiang Soup Dumplings opened its first Georgia location on July 3, 2026, at 3333 Buford Drive, Suite 2022E, in Buford, GA. The New York-based brand, which has been on the Michelin Guide's recommended list for nine consecutive years, serves handmade Shanghai-style soup dumplings and regional specialties. A grand opening celebration is scheduled for August 3, 2026.

Takay is a new 10-seat Japanese omakase restaurant opening on July 10, 2026, at 2296 Coral Way in Miami's Coral Way neighborhood. The restaurant offers Edomae-style sushi in an 800-square-foot space designed by Japan-based firm KTX, with two nightly seatings at 6 p.m. and 9 p.m. The 17-course omakase menu is priced at $250 per person.

Buffalo Wild Wings plans to open its first Kyle, TX, location at 1080 Kohlers Crossing, occupying nearly 5,500 square feet. The franchisee, DLK Foods, is targeting an opening as early as late August or early September 2026. The menu features bone-in and boneless wings, sandwiches, wraps, and a full bar with multiple TVs for sports viewing.

Juanis Restaurant, a Dallas-area Mexican restaurant known for homestyle cooking and made-to-order menus, plans to open a new standalone location at 10830 Harry Hines Blvd within the Grand Bazaar development, targeting late 2026. The new location is independent of any outside administration and marks a significant growth milestone for owner Juana Aguirre. The restaurant's previous location at 10817 Denton Dr. has since closed.

Juanis Restaurant's previous location at 10817 Denton Dr. in Dallas has closed as the owner transitions full operations to the new Harry Hines Blvd location. No closing date is specified in the article.

data.location: 1397 N Highland Ave NE, Atlanta, GA 30306
data.short_description: Alere is a new neighborhood restaurant planned for 2027 at 1397 N. Highland Avenue NE in Morningside Village, Atlanta, developed by the team behind The Chastain. The seasonal menu will draw from Southern European cuisine with locally sourced ingredients and classical cooking techniques. The concept is still in early development and further details will be announced closer to opening.

data.location: 603 N La Cienega Blvd, West Hollywood, CA 90069
data.short_description: The One Rooftop is a new 16,000-square-foot rooftop bar and restaurant set to open in approximately one month at 603 N. La Cienega Blvd in West Hollywood, taking over the former E.P. & L.P. space. The venue will feature a rooftop lounge, outdoor bar, indoor restaurant, and greenspace with views of the Hollywood Hills skyline. It will also offer space for pop-up restaurants, corporate events, film production, and private celebrations.

data.location: 7501 W Cermak Rd, North Riverside, IL 60546
data.short_description: 7 Brew has confirmed a new location coming to the North Riverside Park Mall at 7501 W Cermak Road, with no opening date yet announced. The franchise company responsible for the location is Who Brew, which operates other new 7 Brew shops across Illinois. The menu includes hot and cold brew coffees, energy drinks, fizz drinks, teas, lemonades, and shakes.

Don Ladis Taco Shop, a San Diego-style Mexican restaurant from Gresham, OR, is expanding with a second location at 19850 SE Hwy 212 in Damascus, OR. Owner Sonia Lopez confirmed the expected opening is in August 2026. The menu features carne asada burritos, breakfast tacos, crispy rolled tacos, shrimp tacos, al pastor, weekend menudo, and a salsa bar.

Mazzio's Pizza and Wings in Kilgore, TX, permanently closed on July 3, 2026, after 41 years in business. The restaurant team shared the closure announcement on Facebook, thanking the community for their support but not providing a specific reason for the closure. The location served pizza, wings, and Italian-American favorites and had become a familiar gathering spot for local diners.

Ship Lantern Inn, a century-old fine dining restaurant in Milton, NY, has permanently closed after more than 100 years of service in the Hudson Valley. Owner Mike Foglia, a third-generation family member, cited the lack of a successor as the reason for closure, noting no one in the family was willing to take over the business. The restaurant served contemporary American and Continental cuisine and was known as a destination for special-occasion dining.

Paris Bistro permanently closed on June 7, 2026, ending a 13-year run in downtown Naperville. The French restaurant announced the closure on social media and thanked guests for their years of support. It was known for classic French cuisine, an intimate dining atmosphere, and weekend brunch service.

Celebrity-backed burger chain Wahlburgers closed its St. Charles, IL, restaurant on June 29, 2026, ending the brand's presence in Illinois. The chain announced the closure and stated plans to open a new location in the future, though no details were provided. Wahlburgers continues to operate at its other locations.

My Pi Pizza in Chicago is referenced in the article as one of three Chicago-area restaurants that served its final meals in June 2026, but the article text is cut off before providing details. No address, closing date, or status details are available from the provided text.

Nona's Italian Grill, a nine-year-old Northern Italian restaurant in The Woodlands, permanently closed on June 1, 2026. Founded by Juan Garcia in 2018, the restaurant was known for its homemade pasta and welcoming atmosphere. It had also expanded with a second location in Montgomery's Woodforest area.

data.location: Garden Oaks, Houston, TX (Address not specified)
data.short_description: Pho Fix, a Vietnamese restaurant at The Stomping Grounds in Garden Oaks, served its final meal on June 8, 2026 after five years of operation. The restaurant was known for slow-simmered pho, vermicelli bowls, and banh mi sandwiches. Its menu was inspired by owner Danny Pham's family recipes.

data.location: T.C. Jester Boulevard, Houston, TX (Address not specified)
data.short_description: The T.C. Jester Boulevard location of Juanita's Mexican Restaurant announced its closure on social media on June 25, 2026. The family-owned Tex-Mex restaurant had served the community for 25 years.

Volcano Steak & Sushi is expanding to McDonough, GA with a new location of approximately 7,000 to 8,000 square feet. The new restaurant is expected to open in October 2027. The menu will feature hibachi entrees and specialty sushi rolls.

Decadent Coffee & Dessert Bar is opening a new location in McDonough, GA, opened by local realtor Simmi Patel. The location will feature a contemporary design and spacious dining area. The menu will include skillet cookies, fudge brownies, and specialty mochas.

data.status: expected to open in late summer
data.short_description: Hashtag India is expanding in metro Atlanta with a new Sandy Springs location, following its debut in Suwanee. The new location will occupy a 5,900-square-foot space.

Huey Magoo's is opening its 90th location nationwide at 457 Hialeah Drive, Unit 1, Hialeah, with a ribbon-cutting ceremony on July 11, 2026. Guests can enjoy a buy-one-get-one 5-Piece Tender Meal promotion from July 11–15, plus a "Free Chicken for a Year" giveaway. The chain is known for its hand-marinated, handcrafted chicken tenders made exclusively from chicken tenderloin.

Piccolo Ristorante, a family-owned Italian restaurant, permanently closed on July 3, 2026, ending a 47-year run in Bellmore. Founded in 1979, the restaurant was known for its 9-inch pizzas and classic pasta dishes. Owner Tom Valenti Jr. cited a "myriad of reasons" for the closure.

data.status: customer ready at some point in August
data.short_description: Wonder is opening a new food hall location at 13257 Worth Avenue in Smoketown Station, Woodbridge, VA, expected to be ready in August 2026. Lindsey's Sandwich Shop is taking over the former Frostings Bake Shop space at 4336 Pouncey Tract Road in Short Pump/Henrico, VA. The concept comes from Lindsey Food Group founders Mike Lindsey and Kim Love-Lindsey, who will serve subs, hoagies, focaccia sandwiches, and paninis for lunch and dinner. An opening timeline has not yet been determined.

STK is a Denver-based concept blending a modern steakhouse with a chic lounge atmosphere.

Jack's was founded in 1960 in Alabama and is known for hand-breaded chicken, burgers, and fresh-made biscuits.

El Agave is preparing to open its first Memphis location at 5007 Black Road, with staff recruitment already underway. The restaurant has been active on social media teasing its menu of authentic Mexican cuisine, handcrafted drinks, and chicken wings. No official opening date has been announced.

The restaurant already operates locations in Jackson and Ridgeland, MS, and will serve hummus bowls, Greek wings, and chicken shawarma. The opening is contingent on completing final construction and inspections.

data.status: on track to open this fall
data.short_description: Shivers Creek Catfish House is opening its fourth location at 422 E. Capitol Street in Jackson, MS, with a fall 2026 target. The 6,800-square-foot space will offer al fresco dining front and rear, private dining, and will be the first Shivers Creek location to serve Mississippi craft beers. The restaurant is known for fresh, never-frozen Mississippi seafood.

data.status: expansion remains a priority; no specific sites or opening timelines announced
data.short_description: P. Terry's is planning additional locations in San Antonio as part of its broader expansion following its transition to an Employee Ownership Trust model. JOEY Restaurants, a Canadian premium-casual dining chain founded in 1992 in Calgary, is opening its first Massachusetts location at 250 Northern Avenue in Boston's Seaport, taking over the former Tony C's and Temazcal space. The globally inspired menu will include burgers, tacos, steaks, sushi, and various vegan and vegetarian options. No opening date has been announced.

Daybreak Coffee & Provisions is a new café concept planned to open on-site at Dotty's Kitchen & Raw Bar at 1250 Hancock Street in Quincy, MA. The café will serve specialty coffee drinks including espresso, lattes, cortados, and matcha. No official menu or opening date has been announced.

Ember & Iron, a rustic American fare restaurant from Chef Michael and Brittany Cooney, is opening a new location at 62 Spanish Street in the St. Augustine Historic District. The restaurant will serve the full existing menu plus a seafood program influenced by the Cooneys' other restaurant, Gemma Fish + Oyster. The historic property dates to the Spanish colonial period and was rebuilt in 2025.

data.status: awaiting construction permits; hoping to open before the year is out

The approximately 3,000-square-foot space, formerly a Trek Bicycle store, will seat around 70 customers. The group is hoping to have the location open before the end of 2026.

An additional St. Johns location near International Golf Parkway and Village Commons Drive has also been proposed.

Congaree and Penn, a Jacksonville farm and restaurant, launched The Roost, a new open-air restaurant, on June 19 after the farm's Quonset hut closed for renovation on June 14. The Roost offers a seasonal farm-to-table menu including items like the Farmhouse Burger and Grill Florida Shrimp. A fully enclosed indoor restaurant called "High Horse" is planned to open at the renovated Quonset hut location this winter.

The longstanding Quonset hut at Congaree and Penn held its last day of dining on June 14, 2026, as construction begins to transform it into a fully enclosed, temperature-controlled restaurant. The new indoor concept, to be called "High Horse," is expected to open this winter.

data.status: working toward the goal of a late-September launch
data.short_description: Bebos Cajun Kitchen is a new Cajun-style restaurant opening in Downtown Auburndale, owned by Phillip Robinson, serving dishes like Po Boys, Shrimp & Grits, Jambalaya, and Gumbo. The space at 117 E Lake Ave, Suite 101, will feature green, gold, and black decor with indoor and outdoor seating for about 130 guests. No official opening date has been set, but the owner is targeting a late-September 2026 launch.

data.status: expected to open in late summer 2026
data.short_description: Ron's Gourmet Ice Cream, a family-owned creamery founded in 1976, is expanding with a third location at 305 Washington Street in Westwood's Islington neighborhood, taking over the former Juicygreens space. The Select Board recently approved a new Common Victualler license for the location. The new shop is expected to open in late summer 2026.

Red Mesa Cantina closed its doors at 128 Third St. S in downtown St. Pete in early June 2026 after a 16-year run. The three-story space will be replaced by a new multi-concept restaurant from the team behind Rreal Tacos, expected to start opening in early 2027 in phases. The project represents an eight-figure investment, 250 jobs, and more than 800 total seats.

The development represents an eight-figure investment with more than 800 total seats.

Calle Bistro is a new restaurant opening at 1544 Main St in Downtown Sarasota, offering brunch, dinner, cocktails, and late-night programming including live DJs. Plan review documents confirm the address, though no official opening date has been announced.

data.short_description: Frozen in Time Gourmet Ice Cream, a brand with an existing scoop shop in Crystal River and a food truck, appears to be expanding with a new location at 7810 US Hwy 19, Unit A, in Port Richey based on submitted plan review documents. The menu includes ice cream flavors, sundaes, Boba Tea, and Pup Cups. No opening date or official confirmation was available as of publication.

The team behind Spoke Wine Bar in Davis Square is preparing to open Liars Restaurant in the former True Bistro space at 1153 Broadway in Teele Square, Somerville. Little has been revealed about the concept beyond its Instagram description as the "bigger baby sister" to Spoke Wine Bar. An opening timeline has not yet been shared.

data.store_name: MAX Ultimate Food Café (Smith Family Pavilion)
data.short_description: The Esplanade Association selected Dorchester-based MAX Ultimate Food to operate a new café at the $24 million Charlesbank and Smith Family Pavilion near the Museum of Science, set to open this fall. The all-day café will offer breakfast and lunch fare including coffee, espresso, smoothies, pastries, and avocado toast made with seasonal local ingredients. The pavilion is funded entirely through private donations and will also include the Esplanade's first year-round public restrooms.

Gastronaut is a new cocktail bar and small plates restaurant opening at 72 MacDougal St in the West Village, taking over the former Parcelle wine bar space. The concept is backed by the team behind El Copitas in St. Petersburg and will feature a large selection of international vodkas, Eastern European-inspired dishes with Japanese presentations, and two distinct seating zones including an omakase-style chef's table.

data.location: 417 S. Rosemary Avenue, West Palm Beach, FL (zip not specified)
data.short_description: BuddhaBerry Yogurt Holdings LLC filed permit applications to open a BuddhaBerry location at CityPlace, 417 S. Rosemary Avenue, in West Palm Beach, marking the brand's third location and first outside New York. The shop will offer self-serve frozen yogurt with more than 100 toppings, along with smoothies, bubble tea, coffee, crepes, and waffles. No official opening date has been set, though the brand's Instagram confirms a fall 2026 opening.

data.status: will close, with its final day of service scheduled for July 12
data.short_description: Joystick Gamebar, a retro arcade bar that has operated on Edgewood Avenue in Atlanta for 14 years, announced it will close its Edgewood location with a final day of service on July 12, 2026. The owner did not provide a specific reason for the closure but expressed hope to reopen at a new location.

data.store_name: Sea Salt Beach House (Breakwater Hospitality Group)
data.location: 2400 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
data.short_description: Breakwater Hospitality Group has been selected to negotiate an agreement with the City of West Palm Beach to develop Sea Salt Beach House, a proposed waterfront restaurant at Currie Park as part of a $35 million redevelopment. The approximately 378-seat venue would include indoor dining, covered terraces, open-air seating, and a 320-seat rooftop event space. No timeline has been established.

data.location: 2101 E Cesar Chavez St, Austin, TX 78702
data.short_description: Taqueria Chapala, a family-owned Mexican restaurant operating for nearly three decades, announced it will close its East Cesar Chavez Street location in September 2026 due to a lease renewal dispute with property owners. Co-owner Manuel Lopez stated the property owners confirmed they would not renew the lease, with someone else set to take over the space. The business continues to operate two other locations in the Austin area.

Lucca, a modern Italian trattoria operated by CM Food Co., officially opened its first Florida location at Doral Commons on July 3, 2026, serving house-made pastas, pizzas, and desserts. The restaurant previously operated in Aruba, Panama, and Venezuela, and is part of the 138,000-square-foot Doral Commons retail center. Hours are Sunday–Thursday 11:30 a.m.–10 p.m. and Friday–Saturday 11:30 a.m.–11 p.m.

Cloud Nine Miami, LLC filed permit applications to open Yoghurt & Yoga at 239 Miracle Mile in Coral Gables, transforming the former Edible Arrangements space into a wellness destination combining yoga classes with frozen yogurt, specialty coffee, matcha, and Swedish pastries. An official opening date has not been announced, though an Instagram post confirms a September 2026 opening.

Cafe Rothem, a Korean-style bookstore café in Duluth, announced it will close on July 18, 2026, after 10 years in the community. The owners did not reveal a reason for the closure in their social media announcement, and the café is holding a clearance sale with 40% off books, CDs, and other merchandise.

data.location: 319 NE 167th St, North Miami Beach, FL 33162
data.status: An exact opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: Sterline Vil filed permit applications to open Double Take Market & Eatery at 319 N.E. 167th Street in North Miami Beach, a concept combining specialty grocery shopping with casual dining celebrating Caribbean flavors. The market will feature specialty dry goods, imported Haitian products, fresh seafood, and premium meats, while the restaurant will offer a fusion menu inspired by Haitian, Puerto Rican, Dominican, and American cuisine.

data.location: 1600 N Dixie Hwy, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
data.short_description: Pescatore Ristorante, a family-friendly Italian restaurant in West Palm Beach known for fresh seafood, artisan pizzas, and homemade breads, served its final meal on June 30, 2026. The restaurant shared its closure announcement on social media on July 1, offering no official reason for the closing.

data.location: 1131 Uptown Park Blvd Ste 1, Houston, TX 77056
data.short_description: Uptown Sporting Club, a 5,000-square-foot sports and cocktail lounge, is opening on July 4 at Uptown Park in Houston, offering live sports viewing, upscale dining, handcrafted cocktails, and late-night entertainment with DJs. The concept comes from restaurateurs Roveen Abante and Daniel Chang and features both an indoor lounge and outdoor patio. The venue plans to host watch parties for major sporting events throughout the year.

data.location: 3040 Rigel Ave., Suite 120, Las Vegas, NV 89102
data.short_description: Nacho Daddy, a Las Vegas-based restaurant chain, is opening its fourth Southern Nevada location and sixth overall at 3040 Rigel Avenue, Suite 120, inside AREA15 (Zone 2) on July 3, 2026. The nearly 5,000-square-foot restaurant seats more than 200 guests and features a full bar, large patio, and artwork inspired by AREA15. The opening makes Nacho Daddy the only Las Vegas-founded restaurant operating inside AREA15.

Pizza Guys opened a new location at 2794 W. Ball Road in Anaheim, expanding its footprint in Orange County. The Sacramento-based chain, founded in 1986 with more than 100 locations, offers handcrafted pizza, wings, calzones, sandwiches, and more. The restaurant is locally owned and operated by entrepreneur Kevin Horbakht.

data.location: 231 Grand Ave, South San Francisco, CA 94080
data.short_description: The beloved family-owned Filipino-Chinese bakery and restaurant Ling Nam is preparing to open a new location at 231 Grand Ave in South San Francisco. The expansion is led by second-generation owner Alexson Lim, who aims to continue his father's legacy while modernizing the business. Ling Nam originally operated in South San Francisco for three decades before relocating to Daly City during the pandemic.

data.location: Near BART station, Union City, CA
data.short_description: Ling Nam is also opening a second new location near the BART station in Union City, being opened by Alexson Lim and his wife in the community where they live. The Union City location will include seating and is described as an Express concept. The site was selected for its growing Filipino community and proximity to public transit.

Walnut Street Kitchen, a fine-dining Filipino-American-inspired restaurant that opened in April 2022 near Montclair's Walnut Street Station, will serve its final dinner on July 31. Owner and executive chef Beverly Lacsina cited industry challenges and difficult economic conditions as the reasons for closure. Before closing, the restaurant will host a Filipino-American pop-up dining experience called Bunso from July 7 through July 31.

Walnut St. Bagels & Co., a bakery and bagel shop operating next door to Walnut Street Kitchen, will also close alongside the restaurant. The bagel shop is operated by the same owner, Beverly Lacsina, and shares the same address on Walnut Street in Montclair.

San Babila Café opened its second Manhattan location on July 1 at 1247 Third Avenue on the Upper East Side, serving specialty coffee, gelato, Italian pastries, and light fare. The café was founded by Gianmarco "Gianni" Di Michele and operates as an all-day destination from early morning. The opening was celebrated with free gelato croissants for the first 200 guests.
